data.body: Investigated (debug-everything Phase 1, opus). Root cause (HIGH confidence): completion-verifier Step 4.5 creates OPEN obligation:rollout task children parented to the story under verification, yet P1 gating allows P1=PASS once ticket create succeeds. ticket-transition.sh:320-321 refuses to close a parent with open children, so P1=PASS authorizes a structurally-forbidden closure. check-verifier-verdict.sh routes only on P1 enum, blind to obligations. Live repro: story cca8-f1ed-ddd3-48f1 has open obligation:rollout children 8040-1a28-7621-4363, db61-9fd6-94d2-4b3d. check-obligations.sh:75-76 reads obligation parent from structured parent_id by design, so re-parenting obligations to the epic would misroute the overdue monitor + break schema. Recommended fix: treat obligation:rollout as a non-blocking child class at parent closure (exempt from open-children guard, like orphan-task DEFER), keeping obligation parented+open. Spans safeguard files: ticket-transition.sh (guard), obligation-ticket-schema.md (declare exemption), completion-verifier.md + VERIFIER-PROTOCOL.md (document), tests/scripts/test-verifier-deferred-evidence-contract.sh (currently pins buggy behavior). Classification: COMPLEX + MANUAL_APPROVAL (safeguard). Escalated for /dso:brainstorm + human approval; left open. Full envelope in fix-bug:investigation scratch.
